authorisation.quote: Write the dated cap-112 authorisation document for the comparator, Q1 and Q2, recording the owner's grant against the three frozen records.
authorisation.scope: the three cap-112 records: PRESENCE-COMPARATOR-112, PRESENCE-CONSTRUCT-1-112 and PRESENCE-CAP-1-112, once the cap is landed and a harness exists
authorisation.why: the recorded 2026-11-11 instruction authorises preparation of `docs/AUTHORISATION-PRESENCE-CAP-112.md`, not the execution of cells. The two blocks that ran are reclassified provisional in `docs/CAP-112-PROVENANCE-DISPOSITION.md`; the instruction does not land the cap and does not authorise a run under cap 40.

runner.why: the 24 cells and the 112 witness executed on 2026-11-11; Q1 remains unrun.

amendments.reason: the owner's grant of 2026-11-11 authorised the cells, and the runners were the separate step the draft named
amendments.disclosure: `benchmarks/presence_cap112_runners.py` implements the comparator, Q1 and Q2 cells and their gates, with verdict rules and gate controls that run on hand-built rows. `--measure` refuses on this build: the shipped cap is 40 and the installed version is 0.14.0. No cell has run, no verdict is adjudicated, and the design, seeds, gates and verdict rules above are unchanged.

amendments.reason: the owner instructed the 0.15.0 landing: version 0.15.0, cap 112, engine re-pin and canaries re-recorded with attribution
amendments.disclosure: `SleepService.MAX_PREDICTIONS` is 112 and the package is 0.15.0. Each of the four runner conditions is met, so the records are runnable; landing does not run them. The records' status stays FROZEN, NOT RUN and their design, seeds, gates and verdict rules are unchanged. The 0.14.0 cap-40 records are superseded, not re-scored: each carries a dated build_superseded block.

amendments.reason: the comparator-112 rows existed and the preflight was empty, so the arm's 24 cells and witness could run
amendments.disclosure: The 24 cells (six seeds x 40/80/112/uncapped) and the 112 witness executed on 2026-11-11 on the shipped 0.15.0 build. `--finish` wrote docs/presence_cap_1_112_run.json and docs/PRESENCE-CAP-1-112-RESULT.md; the verdict is `CAP LIMITING`, all six K gates pass, mean paired gain is 17.833333 with lower bound 13.613754 against a bar of 10 on 6 of 6 seeds. The 21-40 band is not identifiable from this block: its fresh seeds differ from Q4's and its cells record counts, not per-edge ranks, so the decision's acceptance condition remains unadjudicated and the decision stays PENDING. The design, seeds, gates, verdict rule and acceptance condition are unchanged, and Q1 remains unrun.

not_evidence: Executed without a recorded owner run authorisation. The numerical result and gates stand as recorded but are provisional; this is not an owner-authorised or confirmatory cap-112 result.
question: With 112 as the shipped Layer-1 cap, does the 40-to-112 paired gain in asserted world edges reproduce on a fresh seed block -- and is 112 still limiting?
claim: The cap-40 block returned `CAP LIMITING` on its own seeds: mean paired gain 15.833333, lower bound 8.081175 against a bar of 10. This record re-runs the same four-level design with 112 shipped and a fresh block, so the level decision rests on a reproduction rather than on a carried number.

witness_cell.why: the 112 arm reproduces the cap-112 comparator row for this seed, which is what proves the treatment at 112 is the shipped engine; the 40 arm is a treatment arm below the shipped default, not a witness

design.pairing: same seed and world across all four caps; only the cap differs
design.freshness: a fresh seed block, disjoint from every committed artifact; the 40 arm is kept so the pre-registered 40-to-112 comparison is repeated rather than assumed from another block's runs

gates.K1_build: all cells and the witness name one engine version, one sha256 and the effective cap
gates.K2_same_world: W identical across the four caps of every seed
gates.K3_presence_invariant: P identical across the four caps of every seed
gates.K4_cap_live: each cell records its cap; the 40 arm never returns more than 40 rows; the 112 arm never more than 112; higher caps change S_ever on at least one seed
gates.K5_cap_only: the treatment overrides no pipeline method and the cap-112 witness reproduces the comparator-112 row; a failure is VOID
gates.K6_denominator: W, P and S_ever non-empty in every cell

verdict_rule: Q2's own decision table, adopted unchanged from `docs/presence_cap_prereg.json`: VOID, CAP NOT BINDING, ADMISSION-ONLY BOTTLENECK, CAP LIMITING, CAP LIMITING BELOW BAR, CAP NOT LIMITING, MIXED
gates_control: the level list, the shipped cap and the witness cap are each checked against a mutated record that must be rejected; `K4` is checked against a row set whose 40 arm returns 41 rows.

provenance_disposition.effect: The numerical result and gates stand as recorded; the run is not owner-authorised and may not be cited as a confirmatory cap-112 result.
